scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.zip: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a release -n mailcow-alias-{version}-chrome.zip -o && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a release -n mailcow-alias-{version}-firefox.zip -o
